description: This file defines a class called FileLoader that extends ResourceLoader and provides methods to load resources from the file system, specifically by converting a filename to a URL and opening an InputStream for the resource.

classes.name: FileLoader
classes.description: A class for loading configuration files from the file system, extending ResourceLoader.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Returns the URL corresponding to a given location string; throws exception if resource is not found.

methods.name: loadResource
methods.description: Opens and returns an InputStream of the resource at the specified location.
